about:
Cutting Edge Electric, Inc. was founded in 1996 in Idaho Falls, Idaho, as a locally owned and operated electrical contracting firm. The company began with a focus on residential electrical work and has since expanded to serve commercial and industrial clients across eastern Idaho.

The company provides a full range of electrical services including repairs, installations, and preventive maintenance. Its technicians handle service panel upgrades, lighting retrofits, new circuit installations, equipment wiring, motor controls, and industrial power distribution. The team works on projects ranging from single-family homes to large industrial facilities, using professional-grade diagnostic tools to troubleshoot wiring faults, motor failures, and control system issues.

Cutting Edge Electric serves residential homeowners, commercial businesses such as offices, retail spaces, and tenant improvements, and industrial operations requiring machinery wiring and automation. Its service area covers Idaho Falls and surrounding communities including Ammon, Blackfoot, Shelley, Rigby, Rexburg, St. Anthony, Ashton, Driggs, and Victor.

The company emphasizes same-day appointment availability, transparent pricing with flexible financing, and a satisfaction guarantee. Its mission centers on combining advanced electrical expertise with unmatched customer service, rooted in integrity and quality workmanship.
